_comment: Fill in and rename to protocol.json, then freeze. chain_hash/chain_public_key are the real drand quicknet values as of 2026-09-09, verified against https://api.drand.sh/<chain_hash>/info; re-confirm at freeze time. Use tools/pick-round.js --in 72h --write to set target_round and submission_cutoff_utc together, so they cannot disagree. chain_public_key is NOT listed in PROTOCOL.md §4 but is required: drand-client verifies a chain only when the hash AND the public key are both pinned - see docs/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md.
